propositions: run_git_write does not retry write-side temp-file faults (ENOENT/EINVAL) because _with_transient_head_retry only matches READ-side signatures (_TRANSIENT_HEAD_MARKERS and _TRANSIENT_OBJECT_MARKERS)
event_append's git add path self-heals via _with_transient_add_retry, while s3_doctor and compaction callers of the shared seam are unprotected against the same fault class
The write-side marker family (_TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS) is duplicated: one copy in gitutil would be recognized by all run_git_write callers, eliminating the asymmetry
Corrupt-object signatures (loose object ... is corrupt, inflate: data stream error) must remain excluded from retry to surface genuine persistent faults
Moving write-side markers into gitutil and consolidating the retry loop eliminates the nested 3x3 budget on commit paths, restoring the intended bounded 3-attempt retry
